DatePrecision.description:
Precision supported by the source text for a date field; null when the date is null.
DAY: day, month and year explicitly stated.
MONTH: month and year explicitly stated.
YEAR: only the year explicitly stated.
DatePrecision.title: DatePrecision

DeliveryStatus.description:
Delivery status of a treatment.
ADMINISTERED: administered.
PLANNED: planned.
HELD: held.
CANCELLED: cancelled.
EXPLICITLY_NOT_RECEIVED: explicitly documented as not received.
NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: none of the above.
DeliveryStatus.title: DeliveryStatus

RadiationField.description: Radiation field used by PCX chart review.
RadiationField.title: RadiationField

RadiationMethod.description: Radiation delivery method used by PCX chart review.
RadiationMethod.title: RadiationMethod

RadiationRoundMention.description:
A single radiation round: method, field, dates, and doses. Emit one per distinct
course of radiation documented in this note. Leave dose fields null when not stated or
not applicable (metastatic-site doses require metastasis; whole-ventricular is only for
germ-cell tumors).

has_mention.description: Indicates whether the concept was mentioned in the text.
has_mention.title: Has Mention

spans.description: The verbatim text where this concept was mentioned.
spans.title: Spans

delivery_status.description: Whether this radiation course was actually delivered. Choose exactly one. A course counts as delivered once any fraction is given; plans, recommendations and simulations are not exposure. ADMINISTERED: at least one fraction was delivered, including a course stopped early. PLANNED: recommended, consented, simulated or scheduled, with no fraction delivered yet. HELD: a scheduled course paused or deferred before the first fraction, with intent to proceed. CANCELLED: a planned course explicitly cancelled before any fraction was delivered. EXPLICITLY_NOT_RECEIVED: the note states the patient did not receive radiation, for example declined, omitted by protocol, or never given. NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: delivery cannot be determined from this note; not evidence of non-receipt.

indication.description: Initial treatment, post-chemotherapy residual/metastatic disease, salvage after relapse or other documented indication. Do not infer from dose.
indication.title: Indication

assessed_through_date.description: Date through which explicit non-receipt or delivery is assessed.
assessed_through_date.title: Assessed Through Date

assessed_through_date_precision.description: Precision for assessed_through_date; null if absent.

dose_verbatim.description: Exact delivered dose(s), field(s) and units; preserve mixed units here instead of assigning incorrect shared units.
dose_verbatim.title: Dose Verbatim

radiation_method.description: Delivery method/energy. PHOTON: photon modality. PROTON: proton modality. COMBINATION_PROTONS_AND_PHOTONS: combination of protons and photons. ELECTRONS: electron modality. THREE_D_CONFORMAL: 3D conformal. IMRT: intensity-modulated. STEREOTACTIC_RADIOSURGERY: SRS. GAMMA_KNIFE: Gamma Knife. BRACHYTHERAPY: brachytherapy. NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: method not established; not evidence of non-receipt; or none of the above.

radiation_field.description: Treated field. CRANIOSPINAL: CSI without a documented boost. CRANIOSPINAL_WITH_FOCAL_BOOST: craniospinal irradiation plus a tumor-bed boost. FOCAL_TUMOR_BED: focal/involved-field only. WHOLE_VENTRICULAR_WITH_FOCAL_BOOST: whole-ventricular plus boost (germ-cell). OTHER: another field. NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: field not stated.

radiation_start_date.description: Round start date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
radiation_start_date.title: Radiation Start Date

radiation_start_date_precision.description: Precision for radiation_start_date. Null when it is null.

radiation_end_date.description: Round end date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not stated.
radiation_end_date.title: Radiation End Date

radiation_end_date_precision.description: Precision for radiation_end_date. Null when it is null.

focal_dose_to_primary_site.description: Focal boost dose to the primary tumor site (numeric, in dose_units). Null if not stated.
focal_dose_to_primary_site.title: Focal Dose To Primary Site

total_dose_to_primary_site.description: Total dose to the primary site (focal + craniospinal/whole-ventricular if given). Null if not stated.
total_dose_to_primary_site.title: Total Dose To Primary Site

focal_dose_to_metastatic_site.description: Focal boost dose to a metastatic site (only if radiation given to metastasis). Null otherwise.
focal_dose_to_metastatic_site.title: Focal Dose To Metastatic Site

total_dose_to_metastatic_site.description: Total dose to a metastatic site (only if radiation given to metastasis). Null otherwise.
total_dose_to_metastatic_site.title: Total Dose To Metastatic Site

craniospinal_dose.description: Craniospinal-axis dose (only if craniospinal radiation given). Null otherwise.
craniospinal_dose.title: Craniospinal Dose

whole_ventricular_dose.description: Whole-ventricular dose (only for germ-cell tumors). Null otherwise.
whole_ventricular_dose.title: Whole Ventricular Dose

dose_units.description: Units for the dose fields in this round. CGY: centigray. GY: gray (=100 cGy). CGE: cobalt gray equivalent (proton). Null if no dose is stated or units are mixed; preserve mixed units in dose_verbatim.

RadiationRoundMention.title: RadiationRoundMention

RadiationUnits.description: Radiation dose units used by PCX chart review.
RadiationUnits.title: RadiationUnits

TreatmentPhase.description:
Treatment phase as documented.
INDUCTION: induction.
CONSOLIDATION: consolidation.
POST_CONSOLIDATION: post-consolidation.
SALVAGE: salvage.
NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE: another documented phase, or phase not documented.
TreatmentPhase.title: TreatmentPhase

description: Radiation-therapy annotations from a single clinical note (a list — rounds repeat).

radiation_rounds.description: All radiation rounds documented in this note; empty list if none.
radiation_rounds.title: Radiation Rounds
